name: Avatar
summary: A person or a workspace shown as an image, initials or an icon, with an optional status dot.
useWhen: Showing who wrote, owns or is assigned to something: a comment, a file, a task
An account menu trigger or a profile header
A workspace or team picker, with shape square
avoidWhen: The person is not known: show nothing or a plain icon
A brand logo or a product mark that must keep its own shape and colors
A large profile photo in a page layout

insteadUse.A large photo or a logo: an img element in a Card media part

name.description: The person or workspace name. The accessible name of the avatar, the source of the initials and of the fallback hue.

src.description: The image URL. Without it the fallback shows at once.

size.description: A square of size.control: 24, 28, 32 and 44 px at default density.

shape.description: default is a circle. square takes radius.sm, for workspaces and teams.

icon.description: A system icon name or a node shown in the fallback in place of the initials. A name with no letters falls back to the user icon.

decorative.description: The name is written next to the avatar. The avatar is hidden from assistive tech so the name is read once.

status.description: Adds the status dot on the end corner: online, away, busy, offline. The status words join the accessible name; the dot is a visual hint, and offline is drawn hollow.

statusLabel.description: The status in words, added to the accessible name. Default Online, Away, Busy or Offline. Pass it in Arabic.

fallbackDelay.description: Milliseconds before the fallback shows while the image loads. Only with src.

onStateChange.description: Called with loading, loaded or error.

a11y.role: img on the root, named by name (and the status words). The image inside has an empty alt; the fallback is aria-hidden.
a11y.focus: Not focusable. Wrap it in a Button or a link to make it interactive; that control then needs its own name.
a11y.announce: The name once, whether the image or the initials show, followed by the status words when status is set. Nothing when decorative.
notes: The name is the alt: the root role img carries it, so a failed image never leaves an unnamed picture.
decorative hides the avatar when the name is written next to it (WCAG 1.1.1).
The fallback is the solid hue of the name with color.text.on-accent: 4.5:1 or more for all ten hues in every style and scheme, tested in Avatar.test.tsx against tokens.css (WCAG 1.4.3).

The status words join the accessible name, so the status never rests on color for assistive tech. Sighted users get color, plus a hollow ring for offline; online, away and busy differ by color only, so write the status in text where it matters (WCAG 1.4.1).
data-state is stamped only when there is an image to load.
decorative hides the status words too: write the status next to the avatar, with the name.

en.name: The full name as the person writes it: Maher Fayad. A workspace by its name: Design team.
en.statusLabel: One word in sentence case: Online, Away, Busy, Offline.

ar.name: The full name, no diacritics: ماهر فياض. Initials skip diacritics and the article ال of the last name.
ar.statusLabel: Noun or adjective, no diacritics: متصل، بعيد، مشغول، غير متصل.

react.note: Motion: fade-rise, the image fades in and rises 2px once loaded (@starting-style, opacity and transform); none under reduced motion. Initials and the hue come from @the-system/shared initials.ts. The status part is drawn by Avatar.css until StatusDot (1.5.10) exists; then it becomes a StatusDot root carrying data-part status.

native.note: Same initials.ts. Image through expo-image with the same fallback rule.

styles.studio: A circle in a pastel hue with ink initials in dark, a deep hue with white initials in light. Pixel icons in the fallback.
styles.desk: The same, with Instrument Sans initials. Square avatars keep radius.sm.
styles.neutral: Planned: follows the tokens, no recipe.

mistakes.wrong: An avatar with alt text next to the same name in text
mistakes.right: decorative, so the name is read once

mistakes.wrong: A status dot as the only sign that someone is offline
mistakes.right: status with statusLabel; offline is drawn hollow

mistakes.wrong: Initials typed by hand, or with Arabic diacritics
mistakes.right: Pass the full name; initials.ts builds them
Wrap it in a Button or a link with its own name
